text:
anna: Heads-up — after the routing-header rename landed in the platform, the Console route-per-model dashboard is showing ~30% of requests as "unattributed". Not sure if this is a telemetry sampling mismatch or SDK header casing.
ben: ugh. saw a few reports. is this only in canary console or everywhere?
anna: mostly in the staging console we use for SDK canaries, but a handful of prod routes flagged too.
carla: timeline? did the platform change include sampling/normalization earlier?
anna: change was the header rename + normalization step shipped yesterday at 16:12 UTC. platform PR mentions lowercasing keys for internal proxies.
mike: that lowercasing was to fix edge proxies in GCP. unfortunately our TS SDK sends `X-Route-Id` and Go/Py were sending `x-route-id` in some codepaths. normalization should have unified, but looks like the console parsing expects original-cased metadata in a few legacy parsers.
ben: so two issues: SDK header variance and console parser that assumes original-case. can we short-circuit by adding a shim in the console ingestion to read both cases?
carla: +1 for shim; low-risk and fast. But we should also audit SDKs to avoid flipping casing again.
anna: agreed. quick fix: console ingestion will try `route-id` / `Route-Id` / `X-Route-Id` fallback. I'll open a tiny roll patch.
mike: for SDKs: Py has a small PR ready to canonicalize headers to lower-case before send. TS has a different codepath where headers are composed by platform agent and may preserve original casing. Go is inconsistent in one internal lib.
ben: let's coordinate releases: Py patch can drop as hotfix (patch semver), TS might require minor bump if we change helper, Go maybe patch. We should avoid breaking users — keep wire-compatible.
carla: doc-wise, we should add a Console note: routing headers are normalized server-side, but SDKs should canonicalize on client side for best signal. Also add a migration checklist for integrators.
anna: who's volunteering to run quick e2e? I can run a staging sweep once console shim is up and SDKs pushed to staging.
mike: I'll open three PRs: go/py/ts. Link them here when ready. Also adding a unit to assert header canonicalization + integration test that ensures console sees attributed routes.
ben: add an automated smoketest for canary deploys: after canary, run a tiny 5-request affinitized trace and assert the console shows correct model/route attribution within 2s. If fails, auto rollback.
carla: that smoketest should live in eng-platform CI. I'll file a ticket — will also surface it in the rollout playbook.
anna: PRs: mike please paste links. I'll queue the console ingestion patch (low-risk) for immediate deploy.
mike: go: https://github.com/redwood/go-sdk/pull/812
carla: noted the CI ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-1428
ben: devex-bot: can we also emit a telemetry event when header normalization fixes are applied so we can measure residual unattributed requests?
devex-bot: Triggered telemetry event request: please include `old_header_variants` and `post_normalization_count`.
anna: good call. I'll add a flagged metric to the ingestion job.
mike: PRs ready for review, one-liners to canonicalize headers:
```python
# py-sdk snippet
headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in headers.items()}
```
```ts
// ts-sdk snippet
const canon = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(headers).map(([k,v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v]));
```
```go
// go-sdk snippet
for k, v := range headers { headers[strings.ToLower(k)] = v }
```
carla: looks fine. watch out for duplicate keys when lowercasing — choose last-write-wins and add a log to CI if duplicates occur.
ben: timeline: console shim deploy in next 30m, Py/Go patch releases in the next 24h, TS minor in 48h (needs small cherrypick). smoketest ticket in triage. if smoke fails, rollback console change.
anna: thanks team. will post status here.
anna: update 1738888920 — console shim deployed to staging; initial staging sweep shows unattributed down to ~2%.
mike: pushed Py/Go patches to staging canary. TS minor cherrypick in progress.
carla: DEVEX-1428 assigned to eng-platform SRE queue.
ben: nice. leave this thread open until we hit <0.5% in prod for one hour. :thumbsup:
anna: will do.
anna: final note for release notes: call out that header canonicalization is internal-only; no customer action needed, but custom proxies that mutate headers may need adjustment.
